name: @privacy-pools-v2/dust-rescue-prover
description: Isolated proving module for cross-chain-reshield stealth dust rescue. Generates the deposit witness/proof + ERC-5564 announcement for a relayer-observed destination-chain leftover, on the relayer's own initiative (see docs/tech-design/sdk/withdraw-and-swap.md §Cross-Chain Reshield). Deliberately separated from packages/relayer/relayer: proving is CPU/memory-heavy and keyless (no chain signer, no custody), unlike the rest of the relayer's thin request/response app — this boundary is what lets it be split into its own deployed process without rework.
